Method addParameter()

Add a new property/parameter for the formulation

Usage

Formulation$addParameter(
  name,
  parName,
  dimension,
  value = 0,
  unit = NULL,
  enum = NULL,
  check = NULL,
  pathPrefix = NULL
)

Arguments

name

Name of the property to add.

parName

Corresponding parameter name of the property to add in the simulation

dimension

Dimension of the property to add.

value

Value for the property.

unit

(Optional) Unit to use for the property. If not given, it is assumed to be the baseUnit of the dimension.

enum

(Optional) Name list mapping user friendly values to PK-Sim allowed values.

check

(Optional) Function to check the validity of the supplied value for the property.

pathPrefix

Corresponding path in the simulation pkml of the property to add. Default to {protocolPrefix}|{formulationName}

Method getAllPropertyPaths()

Get the paths of all parameters defined for the formulation, using protocolName and formulationName

Usage

Formulation$getAllPropertyPaths(
  protocolPrefix = NULL,
  formulationName = self$Name
)

Arguments

protocolPrefix

Name of the protocol in the simulation

formulationName

Name of the formulation in the simulation

Returns

A character vector with the paths of all parameters
